描述_EN: square of monochrome tapestry inserted into a fragmentary linen ground cloth. the frame is composed of a first border decorated with diamond-shaped networks in reserve on a monochrome background, and a second, finer border formed by a frieze of redents in keystones. The center of the square is a medallion featuring three putti.
